<h>Lectio 1</h>
De libro Apocalýpsis beáti Joánnis Apóstoli
<r>Apo 4:1-3</r>
<n>1</n> Post hæc vidi: et ecce óstium apértum in cælo, et vox prima, quam audívi tamquam tubæ loquéntis mecum, dicens: Ascénde huc, et osténdam tibi quæ opórtet fíeri post hæc.
<n>2</n> Et statim fui in spíritu: et ecce sedes pósita erat in cælo, et supra sedem sedens.
<n>3</n> Et qui sedébat símilis erat aspéctui lápidis jáspidis, et sárdinis: et iris erat in circúitu sedis símilis visióni smarágdinæ.
<r>℣.</r> Tu autem, Dómine, miserére nostri.
<r>℟.</r> Deo grátias.

<r>℟.</r> Locútus est ad me unus ex septem Angelis, dicens: Veni, osténdam tibi novam nuptam, sponsam Agni:
* Et vidi Jerúsalem descendéntem de cælo, ornátam monílibus suis, allelúia, allelúia, allelúia.
<r>℣.</r> Et sústulit me in spíritu in montem magnum et altum.
<r>℟.</r> Et vidi Jerúsalem descendéntem de cælo, ornátam monílibus suis, allelúia, allelúia, allelúia.

<h>Reading 1</h>
Lesson from the book of Revelation
<r>Rev 4:1-3</r>
<n>1</n> After these things I looked, and behold a door was opened in heaven, and the first voice which I heard, as it were, of a trumpet speaking with me, said: Come up hither, and I will shew thee the things which must be done hereafter.
<n>2</n> And immediately I was in the spirit: and behold there was a throne set in heaven, and upon the throne one sitting.
<n>3</n> And he that sat, was to the sight like the jasper and the sardine stone; and there was a rainbow round about the throne, in sight like unto an emerald.
<r>℣.</r> But thou, O Lord, have mercy upon us.
<r>℟.</r> Thanks be to God.

<r>℟.</r> One of the seven Angels talked with me, saying: Come hither, I will show thee the bride, the Lamb's wife.
* And I saw Jerusalem descending out of heaven, adorned with her jewels. Alleluia, Alleluia, Alleluia.
<r>℣.</r> And he carried me away in the Spirit to a great and high mountain
<r>℟.</r> And I saw Jerusalem descending out of heaven, adorned with her jewels. Alleluia, Alleluia, Alleluia.

<h>Lectio 2</h>
<r>Apo 4:4-6</r>
<n>4</n> Et in circúitu sedis sedília vigínti quátuor: et super thronos vigínti quátuor senióres sedéntes, circumamícti vestiméntis albis, et in capítibus eórum corónæ áureæ.
<n>5</n> Et de throno procedébant fúlgura, et voces, et tonítrua: et septem lámpades ardéntes ante thronum, qui sunt septem spíritus Dei.
<n>6</n> Et in conspéctu sedis tamquam mare vítreum símile crystállo: et in médio sedis, et in circúitu sedis quátuor animália plena óculis ante et retro.
<r>℣.</r> Tu autem, Dómine, miserére nostri.
<r>℟.</r> Deo grátias.

<r>℟.</r> Audívi vocem in cælo Angelórum multórum dicéntium:
* Timéte Dóminum, et date claritátem illi, et adoráte eum, qui fecit cælum et terram, mare et fontes aquárum, allelúia, allelúia.
<r>℣.</r> Vidi Angelum Dei volántem per médium cæli, voce magna clamántem et dicéntem.
<r>℟.</r> Timéte Dóminum, et date claritátem illi, et adoráte eum, qui fecit cælum et terram, mare et fontes aquárum, allelúia, allelúia.

b.f67ab098e4:
<h>Oratio</h>
<r>℣.</r> Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.
<r>℟.</r> Et clamor meus ad te véniat.
<c>O</c>rémus.
<c>P</c>ræsta, quǽsumus, omnípotens Deus: ut qui paschália festa perégimus, hæc, te largiénte, móribus et vita teneámus.
<h>P</h>er Dóminum nostrum Jesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
<r>℟.</r> Amen.
b.e5577cb863:
<h>Prayer</h>
<r>℣.</r> O Lord, hear my prayer.
<r>℟.</r> And let my cry come unto thee.
<c>L</c>et us pray.
<c>G</c>rant, we beseech Thee, almighty God, that we who have celebrated the Paschal Feast, may, by Thy bounty, retain its fruits in our daily habits and behaviour.
<h>T</h>hrough Jesus Christ, thy Son our Lord, Who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.
<r>℟.</r> Amen.

<h>Martyrologium</h>
<c>Q</c>uarto Idus Aprílis Luna quarta. Anno Dómini 2027
<h>A</h>pud Babylónem sancti Ezechiélis Prophétæ, qui, a Júdice pópuli Israël, quod eum de cultu idolórum argúeret, interféctus, in sepúlcro Sem et Arpháxad, Abrahæ progenitórum, sepúltus est; ad quod sepúlcrum, oratiónis causa, multi conflúere consuevérunt.
<h>R</h>omæ natális plurimórum sanctórum Mártyrum, quos sanctus Alexánder Papa, cum detinerétur in cárcere, baptizávit. Hos autem omnes Aureliánus Præféctus, navi vetústæ impósitos, in altum mare dedúci, et illic, ligátis ad colla lapídibus, mergi præcépit.
<h>A</h>lexandríæ sanctórum Mártyrum Apollónii Presbýteri, et aliórum quinque, qui, in persecutióne Maximiáni, in mare demérsi sunt.
<h>I</h>n Africa sanctórum Mártyrum Teréntii, Africáni, Pompéii et Sociórum; qui, sub Décio Imperatóre et Fortuniáno Præfécto, virgis cæsi, equúleis torti aliísque supplíciis cruciáti, demum cápitis obtruncatióne martýrium complevérunt.
<h>G</h>andávi, in Flándria, sancti Macárii, Epíscopi Antiochéni, virtútibus et miráculis clari.
<h>V</h>allisoléti, in Hispánia, sancti Michaélis de Sanctis, ex Ordine Discalceatórum sanctíssimæ Trinitátis redemptiónis captivórum, Confessóris, innocéntia vitæ, admirábili pæniténtia et caritáte in Deum exímii; quem Pius Nonus, Póntifex Máximus, inter Sanctos rétulit.
<r>℣.</r> Et álibi aliórum plurimórum sanctórum Mártyrum et Confessórum, atque sanctárum Vírginum.
<r>℟.</r> Deo grátias.
b.b70e275416:
<h>Martyrology</h>
<c>A</c>pril 10th 2027, the 4th day of the Moon, were born into the better life:
<h>T</h>he prophet Ezechiel, who was put to death [570 B.C.] at Babylon by a judge of the people of Israel because he had rebuked him for worshipping idols. He was buried in the sepulchre of Shem and Arphaxad, the forefathers of Abraham, and many have been used to resort thither to pray.
<h>A</h>t Rome, very many holy martyrs, who were baptized by holy Pope Alexander, [in the years 101- 109,] while he was kept in prison. The Prefect Aurelian caused them all to be put on board an old ship and carried to the deep sea, where they were drowned, with stones tied round their necks, [in the year 116.]
<h>A</h>t Alexandria, the holy martyrs the Priest Apollonius and five others, who were drowned in the sea in the persecution under the Emperor Maximian.
<h>I</h>n Africa, under the Emperor Decius and the Prefect Fortunian, the holy martyrs Terence, Africanus, Pompey, and their Companions, who were beaten with rods, racked, and tormented in diverse other ways, and at length beheaded, and so finished their testimony.
<h>U</h>pon the same day, [in the year 1012,] holy Macarius, Patriarch of Antioch, famous for his graces and miracles.
<h>A</h>t Valladolid, in Spain, [in the year 1625,] the holy Confessor Michael de Sanctis, a Barefooted Friar of the Order of the Most Holy Trinity for the Redemption of Captives, eminent for the innocency of his life, the wonderful depth of his penance, and his excelling love of God, his name The Supreme Pontiff Pius IX. enrolled among those of the Saints.
<r>℣.</r> And elsewhere many other holy martyrs, confessors, and holy virgins.
<r>℟.</r> Thanks be to God.

b.ebdc957211:
<h>Oratio</h>
<r>℣.</r> Dóminus vobíscum.
<r>℟.</r> Et cum spíritu tuo.
<c>O</c>rémus.
<c>P</c>ræsta, quǽsumus, omnípotens Deus: ut qui paschália festa perégimus, hæc, te largiénte, móribus et vita teneámus.
<h>P</h>er Dóminum nostrum Jesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
<r>℟.</r> Amen.
b.d23df9fc67:
<h>Prayer</h>
<r>℣.</r> The Lord be with you.
<r>℟.</r> And with thy spirit.
<c>L</c>et us pray.
<c>G</c>rant, we beseech Thee, almighty God, that we who have celebrated the Paschal Feast, may, by Thy bounty, retain its fruits in our daily habits and behaviour.
<h>T</h>hrough Jesus Christ, thy Son our Lord, Who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.
<r>℟.</r> Amen.
